# Card price manifest (S18 director round, Chris's note 12)

*Generated by `pnpm tsx scripts/card-manifest.ts` — 102 pool cards (tokens and test cards excluded). Current shop price = round(shopPriceMultiplier × shopBasePrice × (1 + mana value)) = 4 × (1 + mv) at defaults; basics are free. `prizeOnly` cards never appear in shops (Black Lotus). The last column is for the card-by-card tiering audit (Chris + planner): which cards are shop-legal in which towns/rings, and at what multiplier — "spicier" cards (Hymn, Demonic Tutor, Bitterblossom, Baru, Wrath, Serra, Specter, Control Magic…) to be unavailable or dearer.*
